# Writing patterns by component

These are starting shapes. The participant's `component-patterns.md` overrides them.

## Button
Verb first, 1 to 3 words, names the outcome. "Save changes", "Create project". Avoid "Submit", "OK", and "Click here".

## Error message
What happened, then what to do. Do not blame the user. "We couldn't save your changes. Check your connection and try again."

## Empty state
Say what belongs here, then offer the first action. "No projects yet. Create your first project to get started."

## Success toast
Confirm the result in under 60 characters. "Changes saved."

## Tooltip
One sentence that adds information the label cannot carry. Do not repeat the label.

## Form field label and help text
Label names the thing. Help text states format or reason, only when needed.

## Onboarding
Orient, then act. Tell the user what they can do now. Keep warmth in the word choice, not in exclamation points.

## Confirmation dialog
Title states the action and the object. Buttons repeat the action verb. "Delete project?" with "Delete project" and "Cancel".
